reader.requirement: At --std 85, MULTIPLY must obey the scope-of-statements rules (END-MULTIPLY; a conditional MULTIPLY ended by ELSE or a period), the ROUNDED phrase (§1985:VI.6.4.1, rounding before the size check), the ON SIZE ERROR phrase (§1985:VI.6.4.2: phrase taken, affected receivers unchanged, others stored; without it control passes to the end of the statement and NOT ON SIZE ERROR is ignored), the arithmetic-statement rules (§1985:VI.6.4.4: 18-digit operands and composite) and the multiple-results rules (§1985:VI.6.4.6).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 an unphrased size error is caught per receiver and the statement completes (catchesEveryCondition); from 2002 it is a fatal exception condition
CompositeMembers.ReceivingItems85 with Edition.Year < 2002: the composite is the receiving items only (§1985:VI.6.20.3 SR3), capped at Edition.MaxDigits = 18 at 85 (all operands, 31, from 2002)

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectBehavior/Edition.Year/MaxDigits on the MULTIPLY path (ArithmeticBinder, StatementValidation, ArithmeticEmitter); the 19-digit literal refusal (COBOL0802) and ROUNDED MODE IS gate (COBOL0803) are the literal screen's and the construct gate's, both refusing at 85
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: without ON SIZE ERROR, 85 completes the statement (affected receivers undefined) where 2002+ raises a fatal EC-SIZE; the composite is the receiving items capped at 18 at 85 and all operands capped at 31 from 2002; ROUNDED MODE IS exists only from 2014
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf14_05 L5-L9 cover ROUNDED, a size error on one of two receivers, NOT ON SIZE ERROR and END-MULTIPLY inside IF; not exercised: rounding that causes the size error, the unphrased size error at 85, ELSE ending a conditional MULTIPLY, the 18-digit composite and literal caps

probes.expected: M5/M6: 9 * 20 overflows R1 only: phrase taken, R1 20 unchanged, R2 180 and R3 9 stored; M7: 3.2 * 3 = 9.6 ROUNDED to 10, then size error, R3 unchanged 3; M8: unphrased size error on R1, R3 still stored and the next statement runs. All match.

reader.notes: The 1985 arms differ from 2023 (non-fatal unphrased size error, a receivers-only composite at 18 digits, no ROUNDED MODE) and each probe took the 1985 arm correctly. Overlapping operands (VI.6.4.5) are undefined and add no testable requirement beyond the GR1/GR2 temporaries.

refuter.evidence: rmul1.cob at --std 85 (rmul1-001): a delimited MULTIPLY nested in ON SIZE ERROR with the outer NOT ON SIZE ERROR after its END-MULTIPLY: no outer size error N7 OUTER-NOT 54, outer and inner size errors N8 INNER 50 (scope of statements, §1985:IV.6.4.3); GO TO from the phrase N9 50; unphrased size error with NOT ON SIZE ERROR N10 DONE; BINARY and numeric-edited receivers size-checked against the PICTURE (N4, N6). Compile-only at 85: rmul3 an unterminated IF in ON SIZE ERROR refused COBOL2796; rmul5 an unterminated nested MULTIPLY ON SIZE ERROR refused COBOL2796; rmul4 NOT ON SIZE ERROR written before ON SIZE ERROR refused COBOL0900 (the 1985 format prints ON first). cite.py: OK §1985:IV.6.4.3 'the next phrase of the nearest preceding unterminated statement'; OK §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1 'is a conditional statement that is delimited by its explicit scope terminator'; OK §1985:VI.6.4.2. The diagnostics cite §2023 text for 1985 refusals (COBOL2796): a message nit, not a behaviour defect.
